summary: Bishop Collins is a Central Coast (Tuggerah) chartered accounting and audit firm of over 30 staff per its site, with offices in Sydney and Crows Nest. Director Phillip Keenan focuses on property investment and development. The firm sells Xero bookkeeping, cloud migration and outsourced CFO services alongside audit and SMSF work.

hooks.text: Bookkeeping, Xero and outsourced CFO clients mean monthly reconciliations ahead of advice.
Phillip's focus on property investment and development suggests multi-entity clients with many accounts to reconcile (inference).

risks.text: Headcount differs by source (30+ on site; LinkedIn lists 17); audit/tax-heavy firm so bookkeeping may be a minority of work.
Johan Van Der Westhuizen (Audit Director, primary in records) not on the public team list reviewed.

gaps: No job ads, podcasts or posts by Phillip personally found.
Contact page not fetched; Tuggerah head office address varies between pages.
